axes_source: Read from data/brands/slack.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #4A154B and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #1D1D1D on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #4A154B; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 48px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #4A154B reaches 14.00:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
